what_office_does.text: The Treasurer acts as California’s banker, manages state investments, and oversees sales of state bonds and notes. The office also pays out funds when the Controller and other state agencies spend them.
what_office_does.label: fact

candidates.name: Jennifer Hawks

says.text: Hawks says she would strengthen oversight and make it clearer how taxpayer money is managed.
says.label: value

says.text: Hawks says she would insist on measurable results and work to expose waste, fraud, and mismanagement.
says.label: value

says.text: Hawks says she would advocate for responsible investing and greater accountability in handling public money.
says.label: value

candidates.headline: Hawks says she would protect taxpayer money through greater transparency, stronger oversight, and responsible investing.
candidates.core_case: Hawks says her experience managing budgets and improving business operations would guide her work as a financial watchdog. She would focus on transparent spending, measurable results, and responsible management of public money.

candidates.name: Eleni Kounalakis

says.text: Kounalakis says she would use public finance to build more affordable housing.
says.label: value

says.text: Kounalakis says she would invest in children’s and families’ financial futures and protect Californians’ pensions.
says.label: value

says.text: Kounalakis says she would defend health care and immigrant communities as part of her work as Treasurer.
says.label: value

candidates.headline: Kounalakis says she would responsibly manage state finances and invest to strengthen the economy and create opportunity.
candidates.core_case: Kounalakis says her experience building housing, financing infrastructure, and serving as Lieutenant Governor prepares her to manage California’s finances. She would use public finance to expand affordable housing while supporting families’ financial futures and protecting pensions.
priorities: Financial future of children and families

where_they_differ.text: Hawks emphasizes taxpayer protection through transparency, oversight, and measurable results. Kounalakis emphasizes using public finance to expand affordable housing and support families, alongside protecting pensions, health care, and immigrant communities.
